title: Transform to Vastrado-style e-commerce with theme switcher

requirements.text: Transform the home page post-login layout to display a large centered DoRaa Sangam House logo in elegant gold font on dark background at the top center of the page

quotes: Center top: large DoRaa Sangam House logo (use existing luxury logo or text in elegant gold font on dark bg)

acceptanceCriteria: Logo is centered horizontally at the top of the page
Logo uses elegant gold color (#D4AF37 or antique gold from theme) on dark background
Logo is prominently sized and visible on all viewport sizes

requirements.text: Add a horizontal category navigation bar below the logo with five categories: Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All. Style buttons with cyan/teal colors and golden hover glow effects. Make the navigation horizontally scrollable on mobile devices.

quotes: horizontal category navigation bar (responsive, scrollable on mobile): Categories: Shirts, Kurta, Bottoms, Sarees, Shop All (cyan/teal buttons, hover glow)

acceptanceCriteria: Five category buttons are displayed in a horizontal row below the logo
Buttons use cyan/teal color (#14b8a6 or similar)
Buttons display golden glow effect on hover
On mobile viewports, the category bar scrolls horizontally
All categories are visible and clickable

requirements.text: Add a user profile/dashboard icon (circle avatar or icon) in the top right corner of the navigation bar that opens the user dashboard when clicked

quotes: Right side: user profile/dashboard icon (circle avatar or icon, click opens dashboard)

acceptanceCriteria: Profile icon is positioned in the top right corner of the navigation area
Icon is circular and styled consistently with the luxury theme
Clicking the icon opens the user dashboard
Icon has golden hover glow effect matching other interactive elements

requirements.text: Display a grid of product cards below the navigation showing saree products with on-model images, product name, price, discount percentage badge, and Add to Cart button. Cards should have 16px curved corners, subtle shadows, and on hover display lift animation with golden border glow.

quotes: grid of saree/product cards (on-model images, name, price, discount % badge, 'Add to Cart' button)
Cards: curved corners (16px), subtle shadow, hover lift + gold border glow

acceptanceCriteria: Product cards are displayed in a responsive grid layout below the category navigation
Each card shows product image, name, price, discount badge, and Add to Cart button
Cards have 16px border radius and subtle box shadow
On hover, cards animate with a lift effect and golden border glow
Product images show sarees on models
Grid is responsive and adjusts column count based on viewport width

requirements.text: Add an optional hero banner section at the top of the product grid with full-width saree showcase image and overlay text reading 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'

quotes: Hero banner (optional): full-width saree showcase with overlay text 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'

acceptanceCriteria: Hero banner spans full width above the product grid
Banner displays a saree showcase image
Text overlay reads 'New Arrivals - Flat 60% Off'
Text is readable with proper contrast against the background
Banner is responsive on all device sizes

requirements.text: Create a user dashboard page accessible via the profile icon with three tabs: Profile, Orders, and Addresses. Display user profile information including name, email, and phone number with a save button to update the data.

quotes: Clean page with tabs: Profile, Orders, Addresses
Preserve user details (name, email, phone, save button)

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard opens when profile icon is clicked
Three tabs are visible and selectable: Profile, Orders, Addresses
Profile tab displays editable fields for name, email, and phone
Save button updates user profile data in the backend
Dashboard page uses clean, premium styling consistent with the luxury theme

requirements.text: Add a Theme Switcher section in the user dashboard with three theme options: Dark (current #0B0E0C background with white text), Light (white/light gray #F8F9FA background with dark #1A1A1A text), and System (follows OS prefers-color-scheme). Save the user's theme choice in localStorage and apply it on page load.

quotes: Add Theme Switcher section: 3 options (Dark, Light, System)
Dark: current dark theme (#0B0E0C bg, white text)
Light: white/light gray bg (#F8F9FA), dark text (#1A1A1A)
Use localStorage to save theme choice, apply on load

acceptanceCriteria: Theme switcher is visible in the user dashboard
Three selectable options are displayed: Dark, Light, System
Dark theme uses #0B0E0C background with white text
Light theme uses #F8F9FA background with #1A1A1A text
System option detects and follows OS prefers-color-scheme setting
Selected theme is saved to localStorage
Theme is applied immediately on selection
Theme persists across page reloads and sessions

requirements.text: Ensure the light theme maintains clean readability with proper contrast ratios for all text, buttons, and interactive elements while preserving the premium luxury aesthetic

quotes: Keep dark luxury base, but make light theme clean & readable

acceptanceCriteria: All text in light theme has sufficient contrast (WCAG AA minimum)
Buttons and interactive elements are clearly visible in light theme
Golden hover effects are visible against light backgrounds
Light theme maintains premium, luxury visual styling
No readability issues or visual glitches in light mode

requirements.text: Apply golden hover glow effects consistently across all buttons, icons, and interactive elements in both dark and light themes
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons display golden glow on hover
All icons display golden glow on hover
Hover effects work in both dark and light themes
Glow effect is smooth and consistent across all interactive elements

requirements.text: Ensure the entire interface is fully responsive: on mobile devices, categories scroll horizontally, logo remains centered, and product grid adjusts to single or two-column layout

quotes: Responsive: mobile pe categories horizontal scroll, logo center

acceptanceCriteria: On mobile viewports (< 768px), category navigation scrolls horizontally
Logo remains centered on all screen sizes
Product grid displays 1-2 columns on mobile devices
All elements are usable and properly sized on mobile
No horizontal overflow or layout breakage on small screens

requirements.text: Require user authentication to access the dashboard and perform cart actions. Display a login prompt or redirect to login page when unauthenticated users attempt to access protected features.

quotes: Login required for dashboard & certain actions (show login prompt if not logged in)

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users cannot access the dashboard
Clicking profile icon when not logged in shows login prompt or redirects to login
Cart actions require authentication
After successful login, users are redirected to their intended destination
Login prompt is clear and user-friendly

requirements.text: Preserve all existing functionality including Internet Identity authentication, OTP login flows, shopping cart operations, and category carousel features without introducing regressions or bugs

quotes: No other changes: preserve login/OTP, Internet Identity, cart, category carousel if present

acceptanceCriteria: Internet Identity login flow works without issues
OTP authentication flow remains functional
Shopping cart add/update/remove operations work correctly
Existing category carousel (if present) continues to function
No blank screens or JavaScript errors occur
All existing features remain operational after the transformation

requirements.text: Generate five generated product images showing sarees on models for use in the product grid, each with dimensions 800x1000 pixels and visually distinct styles
acceptanceCriteria: Five product images are generated and placed in frontend/public/assets/generated
Each image shows a saree worn by a model
Images have 800x1000 pixel dimensions
Images represent visually distinct saree styles (Banarasi, silk, organza, etc.)
Images are used in product cards on the home page grid

constraints: Do not edit any files in frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve the royal Banarasi-Kanpur luxury color scheme (deep plum #4A1942, antique gold #D4AF37, warm ivory #F8F4E3)
Maintain single-actor Motoko backend architecture in backend/main.mo
nonGoals: Changing the backend data schema or storage structure
Adding real-time features like WebSockets or live chat
Integrating third-party payment processors beyond Razorpay
Implementing admin product management features (already exists)
Adding social media integration or sharing features

required: Elegant saree on model with Banarasi zari work, rich red and gold colors (product-banarasi.dim_800x1000.png)
Luxurious silk saree on model with flowing drape, deep purple and silver (product-silk.dim_800x1000.png)
Lightweight organza saree on model with subtle patterns, pastel pink and gold (product-organza.dim_800x1000.png)
Traditional georgette saree on model with embroidery, teal and gold accents (product-georgette.dim_800x1000.png)
Kalamkari print saree on model with artistic motifs, cream and brown tones (product-kalamkari.dim_800x1000.png)
